answer: Each agent must post a bond locked for a fixed period, and a randomly selected peer group audits its signed work before the bond is released. If an agent is caught duplicating identities to collect rewards, the protocol slashes its bond and excludes linked keys; repeated audits make each new persona another liability. The ridge, onyx, and tundra markets can set different bond sizes, but the attacker still has to immobilize real capital for every identity and risks losing it.
